footer.tagline: Your place on earth, where time moves a little slower.

hero.title: Your Masurian hideaway
hero.subtitle: A minimalist lake house surrounded by forest.

amenities.title: Why Lagom Masuria
amenities.subtitle: Everything you need for deep rest, designed with attention to every detail.
amenities.jacuzziDesc: A private outdoor relaxation zone, perfect for unwinding under the stars in the evening.
amenities.forestDesc: Immerse yourself in the scent of pine forest. Our plot borders a protected nature reserve.
amenities.lakeDesc: Only 500m separates you from Garbas Lake, with a wild, scenic path down to the water.

interior.title: An interior full of light
interior.desc: Designed in harmony with the Lagom philosophy - neither too little nor too much. A spacious living room with fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, and forest-view bedrooms create a comfortable retreat for up to 6 guests.

house.title: About Our House
house.desc: Designed around the 'Lagom' philosophy - just right. Our house is a place where Scandinavian minimalism meets the warmth of the Masurian landscape. We offer space to breathe and slow down in the heart of nature in Stare Juchy.

outdoor.title: In the open air
outdoor.description: Slow mornings, shared meals and evenings by the fire. There is room here to unwind at your own pace.
outdoor.imageAlt: Outdoor surroundings of Domek na Mazurskiej
outdoor.woodTerms: The first bag of firewood is included in your stay. Additional bags cost extra — we will agree the price before arrival.

family.title: Active days for the family
family.description: A kickabout, time playing in the yard or a trip around the area. Mix quiet moments with outdoor activities.
family.imageAlt: The Masurian landscape around the house
family.equipmentTerms: Bicycles and SUP are available by prior arrangement.

indoor.title: Comfort indoors
indoor.description: Make your morning coffee in the kitchen, cool down on a warm day and enjoy a relaxed evening in the living room.

pond.title: Panorama of the Masurian hills
pond.desc: Rolling countryside towards the village of Liski, with a private pond in the distance — the view that comes with your morning coffee on the terrace.

kayak.title: Kayaks & SUP
kayak.desc: Explore the calm waters of the surrounding lakes at your own pace. SUP is available by prior arrangement.

bike.title: Cycling trips
bike.desc: Hundreds of kilometres of forest paths and scenic trails around Stare Juchy.

fishing.title: Fishing
fishing.desc: Take the small rowing boat out at dawn for a quiet catch — available on site for our guests.

food.title: Local cuisine
food.desc: Discover regional flavours with our trusted local hosts.

garbas.title: Garbas Lake
garbas.desc: A wild, scenic path down to the water, tucked away in nature — a perfect walk for a summer morning.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Discover the harmony of nature and minimalist design. Our interiors and surroundings were created to give you space to truly breathe.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Clear rules for your comfort.
pricing.loadError: Pricing could not be loaded. Please try again or contact us to confirm the price.
pricing.empty: Pricing is currently being updated. Please contact us to agree the price of your stay.

booking.title: Check Availability
booking.subtitle: Choose your dates and send a booking request for your stay in the heart of nature. We'll contact you to confirm the dates.
booking.datesSubtitle: Minimum stay is 2 nights. The estimated price updates automatically.
booking.noPricing: No pricing is available for the entire selected stay. Choose different dates or contact us.
booking.summarySubtitle: Double-check your details before sending the request. You can still go back and edit them.
booking.confirmationMessage: Your dates are held immediately for up to 24 hours while you wait for the owner's decision. This is not yet a confirmed stay; the hold expires at the deadline below.
booking.notificationInfo: An informative email is sent or queued. No action or email verification is required. After the owner's decision, you will receive confirmation with the final price, deposit and balance, or a rejection email.
booking.fillDetailsError: Fill in all required guest details
booking.unavailableError: Selected dates are unavailable. Please choose different dates.

links.verifyHelp: Check the dates and price. Only this button creates a provisional 24-hour hold. This is not a final booking confirmation.
links.decisionHelp: Your decision is saved only after pressing the button. Confirmation queues an email to the guest; rejection releases the hold.
links.pendingResult: Request received. Your dates are provisionally held for 24 hours, awaiting the owner's decision.
links.confirmedResult: Booking confirmed. The guest confirmation email is queued for delivery.
links.rejectedResult: Request rejected. Its provisional date hold has been released.
links.invalid: This link is invalid, expired or the request has already been processed.
links.error: We could not confirm the result. Check your connection; retrying will not create a second booking.
links.priceChanged: The price has changed. Check the updated amount and confirm again if you accept it.
links.reopen: To try again, reopen the link from your email.
links.checkEmailHelp: We sent a link valid for 15 minutes. Verify your email to request a booking. Dates are not held yet; availability and price will be checked again.
links.rateLimited: The request limit was reached. Please wait before retrying or contact us by phone.
links.retryAfter: Try again in about {{minutes}} min, or contact us by phone.
links.datesUnavailable: These dates are no longer available. Return to the calendar and choose a different stay.
links.emailFailed: The mail server did not confirm sending the message. Dates have not been held. Wait before retrying or contact us by phone.
links.availabilityError: We could not check availability. Please refresh the calendar.

priceEdit.error: Could not save the price. The booking may have been handled or expired. Refresh the list and try again.
priceEdit.unsaved: Save or cancel price changes and save the deposit before confirming.

pricingEditor.help: Saved prices and dates are used on the website and for new quotes. Season boundary dates are inclusive, and holidays take priority. Existing booking prices remain unchanged.
pricingEditor.invalidPrice: Enter a valid price above zero, up to 99999999.99 PLN, with at most two decimal places.
pricingEditor.invalidDates: Enter both dates. The end date must not precede the start date.
pricingEditor.overlap: Low and high seasons must not overlap. Correct the season dates.
